paragraphs: Geviah bar Kosem; [Bereshit Rabbah 61:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.61.7). Hyman’s “our reading” in [Sanhedrin 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.91a.7) is Geviha ben Pesisa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Bereshit Rabbah calls Alexander’s interlocutor Geviah ben Kosem. Hyman writes bar Kosem. The Sanhedrin passage gives Geviha ben Pesisa.

[Heilprin’s Kosem notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=830&lang=en) refers readers to [his longer entry on Geviha ben Pesisa](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=825&lang=en), where he records differing accounts of the names.
